article.title: EPP, right-wing groups halt EP rule-of-law monitoring mission to Italy
article.summary:
(ANSA) - ROME, SEP 2 - A bid to stage a European Parliament mission in Italy to assess the state of democracy and the rule of law here was halted on Tuesday by the votes against of members of centre-right and right-wing parties, sources said on Wednesday.
The Parliament's Committee on Civil Liberties (LIBE) rejected a motion to stage the monitoring mission proposed by the Socialists, Greens, and the Left due to the nays of the centre-right EPP and the right-wing ECR, Patriots and ESN groups Premier Giorgia Meloni's Brothers of Italy (FdI) party is in the ECR, Deputy Premier and Transport Minister Matteo Salvini's League is in the Patriots, and Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani's Forza Italia is in the EPP.
The committee did, however, vote in favour of the mission to Greece and confirmed one in Hungary, meaning the spot for one more mission remains to be decided, with Romania the favourite to be picked. (ANSA).Read article...

article.title: Deported Milo Yiannopoulos disavows Trump
article.summary: Milo Yiannopoulos is a right-wing agitator who was once so controversial that the American right cancelled him. Although he’s never regained the notoriety he enjoyed in the 2010s, he has survived on the fringes of online media.
